title: Lantern Lake Fishing [not translated: the whole title is still English in Latin script]
hud.cast: Throw [bare verbal noun 'throwing'; does not mention the line or rod, so the fishing sense comes only from context]
hud.reel: Pull [bare verbal noun 'pulling'; the same word commonly means 'withdraw' (money) or 'draw' (as in a lottery or gacha draw)]
shop.rods: Rods [the word can mean fishing rods or fish hooks]
shop.buy_robux: Buy for {price} Robux [Robux left in Latin script inside Arabic text; likely intended]
pass.auto_reel: Auto pull [can also read as 'automatic withdrawal', the usual banking term, or 'auto draw']
pass.lucky_bait: Luck Bait doubles your chance of catching rare fish! [the verb usually means 'doubles' but can loosely mean 'multiplies']
sell.prompt: Press E to sell [Latin key letter 'E' in Arabic text; likely intended]
ascend.confirm: Ascend now? You will start over, but you will catch rare fish {bonus}% more. [opens with a bare noun, 'Ascension now?', which is a little stiff]
weather.storm: A storm is approaching! Rare fish are taking the bait now.
quest.title: Quests
friends.boost: Fishing with friends increases your luck by {percent}%
afk.kicked: You were inactive for a long time, so you stopped fishing. [says the player stopped fishing, not that the game stopped or removed them; the unvoweled verbs can also be read as 'I']
event.ends: Ends in {time} [verb is masculine, 'it ends', so it agrees with a masculine noun like 'event' but not a feminine one like 'storm']
daily.streak: Day {day} in a row! More rewards are waiting for you tomorrow. [the word for 'the day' also means 'today', so it can read 'Today {day} in a row'; an ordinal would read more naturally]
tip.night: Tip: Some fish only take the bait at night.
group.join: Join our community and get 50 bait for free!
